subject.title: Feature: Agent 动态切换命令（不重启 Gateway）

question: Should OpenClaw add a channel-visible, session-level command that switches the active agent for a conversation without changing static bindings or restarting Gateway?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent contract changes channel command authorization, persisted session state, cross-agent isolation, audit/recovery, and workspace/credential boundaries, so automation should not choose the product/security boundary.

options.title: Design a gated core command
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, persistence, rollback/audit, static-default routing, and switched-routing tests before implementation.

options.title: Keep bindings static
options.body: Decline runtime channel switching and keep configured bindings plus restart or approved reload as the supported cross-agent routing model.

options.title: Expose an extension point first
options.body: Require a generic channel/session-routing extension point before shipping a concrete `/agent` command in core.

recommendation.title: Design a gated core command
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a small design covering authorized senders, persistence, rollback/audit, static-default routing, and switched-routing tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The requested behavior extends the multi-agent routing boundary he introduced and needs product/security ownership across routing, sessions, and channel commands.
